DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity.

The chest X-ray findings of ground-glass opacities and air bronchograms, combined with the respiratory acidosis and normal echocardiogram, confirm the diagnosis of RDS. The maternal diabetes and C-section may have contributed, but the primary pathology is alveolar collapse due to surfactant deficiency.
